label: Currency Pound
depicts: Pound currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the pound symbol enclosed inside a thin circular frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standalone pound sign when the outer ring should not be visible.

label: Currency Pound
depicts: Standalone pound currency sign with one crossbar and one curled top
use_when: Use when the interface wants the pound sign by itself with its curled top and single bar.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring pound sign when the symbol should stay inside a circle.
